<translated_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class MinCostMaxFlow {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int to, flow, cost, rev;
        Edge(int t, int f, int c, int r) : to(t), flow(f), cost(c), rev(r) {}
    };

    int N, S, T;
    int maxFlow, minCost;
    const int INF = 1e9;

    vector<vector<Edge>> al;
    vector<vector<Edge>> ja; // array of arrays after conversion
    vector<int> d; // potentials

    MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink) : N(n), S(source), T(sink), maxFlow(0), minCost(0) {
        al.resize(N);
        d.assign(N, 0);
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
        int lu = al[u].size(), lv = al[v].size();
        al[u].emplace_back(v, flow, cost, lv);
        al[v].emplace_back(u, 0, -cost, lu);
    }

    void convertToArray() {
        ja.resize(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            ja[i] = al[i];
            al[i].clear();
        }
    }

    bool BellmanFord(bool check) {
        fill(d.begin(), d.end(), INF);
        d[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (const Edge& e : ja[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    if (d[j] + e.cost < d[e.to]) {
                        d[e.to] = d[j] + e.cost;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (check) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (const Edge& e : ja[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    if (d[j] + e.cost < d[e.to]) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    // SPFA (simple)
    vector<int> node, visit, prv, prve, dist;
    bool simple() {
        node.assign(N, 0);
        visit.assign(N, 0);
        prv.assign(N, -1);
        prve.assign(N, -1);
        dist.assign(N, INF);

        node[0] = S;
        dist[S] = 0;
        int front = 1, back = 0;
        while (front != back) {
            int u = node[back++];
            if (back == N) back = 0;
            int distu = dist[u];
            visit[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[u].size(); i++) {
                const Edge& e = ja[u][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cdist = distu + e.cost;
                if (cdist < dist[e.to]) {
                    if (visit[e.to] == 0) {
                        node[front] = e.to;
                        if (++front == N) front = 0;
                    } else if (visit[e.to] == 2) {
                        if (--back == -1) back += N;
                        node[back] = e.to;
                    }
                    visit[e.to] = 1;
                    prve[e.to] = i;
                    prv[e.to] = u;
                    dist[e.to] = cdist;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    bool dijkstra() {
        visit.assign(N, 0);
        prv.assign(N, -1);
        prve.assign(N, -1);
        dist.assign(N, INF);
        priority_queue<pair<int,int>, vector<pair<int,int>>, greater<pair<int,int>>> pq;
        pq.emplace(0, S);
        dist[S] = 0;
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            int du = p.first, u = p.second;
            if (du != dist[u]) continue;
            visit[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[u].size(); i++) {
                const Edge& e = ja[u][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cdist = du + (e.cost + d[u] - d[e.to]); // reduced cost
                if (cdist < dist[e.to]) {
                    if (visit[e.to] == 2) return false;
                    pq.emplace(cdist, e.to);
                    dist[e.to] = cdist;
                    prv[e.to] = u;
                    prve[e.to] = i;
                    visit[e.to] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    int augment() {
        int p = T;
        int minFlow = INF;
        while (p != S) {
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            minFlow = min(minFlow, ja[pp][pe].flow);
            p = pp;
        }
        p = T;
        while (p != S) {
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            ja[pp][pe].flow -= minFlow;
            ja[p][ja[pp][pe].rev].flow += minFlow;
            p = pp;
        }
        maxFlow += minFlow;
        return minFlow;
    }

    bool calSimple() {
        while (simple()) {
            minCost += dist[T] * augment();
        }
        return true;
    }

    void updPotential() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (visit[i] != 0) {
                d[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
            }
        }
    }

    bool calWithPotential() {
        while (dijkstra()) {
            int min = dist[T] + d[T] - d[S];
            minCost += min * augment();
            updPotential();
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    int maxl = n + k;
    int T = n * maxl + 1;
    MinCostMaxFlow mcmf(T + 1, 0, T);

    vector<int> a(k + 1), f(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
        f[a[i]]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (f[i] == 0) continue;
        mcmf.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
            mcmf.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
            for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                if (a != 1)
                    mcmf.addEdge(n * l + a, n * (l + 1) + b, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                if (b != 1)
                    mcmf.addEdge(n * l + b, n * (l + 1) + a, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
        mcmf.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
    }
    mcmf.convertToArray();
    mcmf.calSimple();
    if (mcmf.maxFlow != k) {
        cout << "BUG\n";
    } else {
        cout << (int)mcmf.minCost << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
